This game was interesting for maybe the first week as it was brand new, but after a while it just become very repetitive and quite boring which is why I dropped it. They honestly dropped the ball on this.

AGS has done a lot to improve the game - and to be fair SG has too but its still completely inaccessible to new players, and the post 1600 grind is pure pain. All the legacy horizontal systems need to be trashed, gold sinks need to be removed or capped, and we need balance patches globally much sooner. Raid design is pretty good still, but class balance is kinda funny with power creep and faster raids throwing previously S class builds in the trash. Dont play slow or front attack classes. Skins are still garbage, end game grind is pain and is a full time job to keep up. RMTers go unpunished and the economy is starting to go out of control again.

Do not play this game if you want to have fun.
Play this game if you like to work and wouldnt mind having a second unpaid job.

For someone with a decent computer (i7, 1070, SSD) this game takes an obnoxious amount of time to load and I get a lot of random lag/stutters in game (Especially when that stupid shop opens because I hit the wrong key)

I want to love this game. The UI/UX design and look are damn near perfect. I love the controls and the way the classes work. There are a ton of things about this game that I think would have made this game probably my top MMO of all time.

But once you get past the initial questing and get into end game content there are very few unique things to do. I know "the grind" is a part of most MMO's. But LostArk felt excessive with it. Often taking days to see basically any progress.

Still, I could almost forgive that. The game is still fun with friends... except for the Pay 2 Win side of things. PvP was a complete write-off for me because there were people that could literally pay to bypass that grind. There are even some slight stat bumps in some of the cosmetics? I mean the one time I bought something was a skin for my ship, because it added features to make it run faster... for real money.

Maybe I'll return to it one day. I would love to see it change. But I doubt it.
